api_gaps.operation: breaker: break a target block and atomically put its actual drops into the router buffer
api_gaps.missing: A server-authoritative transaction that checks protection/tool/loot, blocks removal if the output cannot fit, then commits block removal and complete drops together.

api_gaps.missing: A transaction that reads the authoritative ItemStack, inserts it with components/stack limits, and only then consumes or reduces the world entity.
